tools.name: queue
tools.description: The GPU/NPU queue right now: which queued command holds the turn (pid, session, command, device, how long) and which wait, in order. Use it when a job seems stuck on its GPU or NPU.

tools.name: queue_stop
tools.description: Stop the command that holds the GPU/NPU turn: SIGTERM to its whole command, after the user approves. Only when the user asks, or a holder is clearly stuck.
